clips.title: The story
paras: The Church of the Holy Light is the dominant religious institution of humanity, guiding mortal souls through the virtues of compassion, justice, and devotion. Originally centered in the lost northern kingdom of Lordaeron, its leadership now resides within the grand Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City following the devastation wrought by the Scourge.

The Church's origins reach back over a millennium to the faith in the Holy Light that took root among the humans of Arathor, teaching them to channel sacred power to cure injuries and purge affliction. Driven by tenets of charity, righteousness, and the fundamental belief that the Light resides within all thinking beings, these teachings eventually coalesced into an organized faith. The kingdom of Lordaeron became the religious heartland of this doctrine, establishing revered sanctuaries throughout the north, including Stratholme, Andorhal, Tyr's Hand, and Light's Hope Chapel.
